cover_headline: India Crosses 1 Crore HPV Vaccine Doses in Less Than Nine Months
facts: India administered over 1 crore HPV vaccine doses in under nine months
The campaign targets 1.2 crore 14-year-old girls annually
Six states achieved 100% coverage of their target populations

end.headline: India Crosses 1 Crore HPV Vaccine Doses in Less Than Nine Months
end.line: The national campaign has reached nearly 87% of its target cohort of 14-year-old girls, with six states reporting full coverage of their identified populations.
